lesson.beat.cover.body2: First, one whole life in half a minute. Then a hike, and a girl with two paths.
lesson.beat.life.heading: Many paths. Here’s one.
lesson.beat.life.choir: His parents sign him up for choir.
lesson.beat.life.band: He starts a band with two friends.
lesson.beat.life.song: The band writes its own song.
lesson.beat.life.radio: A radio DJ plays it. Luck!
lesson.beat.life.record: A record label signs the band.
lesson.beat.life.fame: Fame. Late nights, bad habits, money gone.
lesson.beat.life.splits: The band splits. He loses his flat.
lesson.beat.life.help: A friend takes him in. He asks for help.
lesson.beat.life.school: He teaches music at the local school.
lesson.beat.life.stage: He watches his daughter sing on stage.
lesson.beat.life.alt: One life grows along an age line from birth to 41, one fork at a time, with gray lines leaving every fork for the choices Sam didn’t make. It rises after a lucky radio play and a record deal, tips down with fame, drops when the band splits and he loses his flat, and climbs again after he asks for help: teaching guitar, two kids, a job teaching music at the local school, his daughter on stage. Light green paths carry on past 41.
lesson.beat.life.altEnd: After the story you can change one of Sam’s choices and watch a different life grow from that fork, with his real path still there behind it.
lesson.beat.adds.heading: Choices add up.
lesson.beat.adds.body1: Choir led to guitar, guitar to a band, the band to a song. Luck lifted Sam’s path. A hard year pushed it down. Not everything was his to choose. Now let’s look at choices over just a few days.
lesson.beat.adds.alt: Sam’s whole route, with three labels: His choice on the guitar point, Luck on the radio point, Not his choice where the band splits.
opening.end.heading: One life, one path.
opening.end.gray: Every gray line is a life Sam could have lived.
opening.end.announce: One life, one path. Every gray line is a life Sam could have lived.
opening.alt.label: {choice}, instead of {instead} at {age}

opening.choose.announce: Five of Sam’s choices can change. Pick one of the gray choices.

opening.whatif.heading.schoolTeam: What if Sam had joined the school team?
opening.whatif.heading.earlyNights: What if Sam had kept early nights?
opening.whatif.heading.savesMoney: What if Sam had saved his money?
opening.whatif.heading.movesHome: What if Sam had moved back home?
opening.whatif.heading.officeJob: What if Sam had taken an office job?
opening.whatif.same: The same life as Sam’s until age {age}. Then:
opening.whatif.note: A made-up life, like Sam’s. Not better or worse, just different.
opening.whatif.alt: Sam’s real path stays on the map in light green. A new dark path grows from the fork along the choice he didn’t make, to age 41, with its own choices, luck and setbacks.
